rationale: Builds on the current recurrent-tail baseline with a compact curriculum change instead of another scalar sweep. Earlier recurrent tail blocks now stay fully off until their stage opens, concentrating limited Mac-mini step budget on the deepest repeated block first; the carry path is also gain-squared so anchor pull stays weaker during partial activation. This is a compile-stable structural edit aimed directly at final int8 roundtrip behavior, while keeping the script lean and preserving the existing export-aware endgame.
title: Staged Reverse-Tail Recurrence Sparsification
